name: crypto_price
description: Retrieves real-time price data for any cryptocurrency listed on CoinGecko. Returns the current price in any fiat currency, 24-hour percentage change, market capitalisation, and 24-hour trading volume. Supports all major cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), XRP, Cardano (ADA), Dogecoin (DOGE), Polygon (MATIC), Chainlink (LINK), Avalanche (AVAX), and 10,000+ additional coins. Use this tool when an agent needs the current price of any digital asset, needs to value a cryptocurrency holding in fiat, monitor portfolio performance, or report on crypto market conditions. Do not use this tool for fiat-to-fiat currency conversion (e.g. USD to EUR) — use currency_convert instead. Do not use when historical price data for a specific past date is required — this tool returns live spot prices only.

coin.description: Cryptocurrency name or ticker symbol. Accepts common symbols (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, MATIC, LINK, AVAX) or full names (bitcoin, ethereum, solana). Case-insensitive.

currency.description: Target fiat currency code for the price. Must be a valid ISO 4217 code. Defaults to USD. Examples: usd, eur, gbp, jpy, chf, aud, cad.

include_market_data.description: Whether to include market capitalisation and 24-hour trading volume alongside the price. Defaults to true. Set to false for a lighter response when only the price is needed.

coin_id.description: CoinGecko canonical identifier for the coin, e.g. 'bitcoin'.

coin_input.description: The coin value as provided by the caller.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code the price is expressed in.

price.description: Current spot price of the coin in the requested fiat currency.

change_24h_pct.description: Percentage price change over the last 24 hours. Negative values indicate a decline.

market_cap.description: Total market capitalisation in the requested fiat currency. Null if include_market_data is false.

volume_24h.description: 24-hour trading volume in the requested fiat currency. Null if include_market_data is false.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when CoinGecko last updated this price.
